_comment: PM OS recommended Claude Code hooks. Copy the 'hooks' array into .claude/settings.json to activate.

hooks._comment: Remind to commit after significant file writes to execution/

hooks.command: node -e "const f=process.env.TOOL_RESULT_FILE_PATH||''; if(f.includes('execution/') && (f.endsWith('.md')||f.endsWith('.yaml'))) { console.log('PM OS: Artifact written to execution/. Consider committing: git add execution/ && git commit -m "add artifact"'); }"

hooks._comment: Block writes to pm-os-reference/ — that directory is read-only reference material

hooks.command: node -e "const f=process.env.TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH||''; if(f.includes('pm-os-reference/') && !f.includes('phase-history') && !f.includes('phase-evolution') && !f.includes('documentation/QUALITY_METRICS_DASHBOARD')) { process.exit(1); }" 2>/dev/null || echo 'PM OS: pm-os-reference/ is read-only. Use execution/ for your work.'

hooks._comment: Warn if editing identity/ files without a backup — these are critical context files

hooks.command: node -e "const f=process.env.TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH||''; if(f.includes('/identity/') && (f.endsWith('STRATEGY.md')||f.endsWith('STANDARDS.md'))) { console.warn('PM OS: Modifying identity/ file. Ensure changes are intentional — agents use these files for all outputs.'); }"

_usage_notes: Add the 'hooks' array above to .claude/settings.json (do NOT add the _comment fields)
Hooks use node.js — ensure node is in your PATH
TOOL_RESULT_FILE_PATH and TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH are injected by Claude Code
PreToolUse exit(1) blocks the tool call — use sparingly
PostToolUse runs after the tool completes — safe for logging/reminders
